text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated so much as may be necessary to implement Article X, Section 10 of the Constitution up to the
end of the current fiscal year. Thereafter, the necessary appropriation therefor shall be included in the annual
General Appropriations Decree.

The payment of the salaries as provided in the Constitution and as funded herein shall retroact to
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
